messages:
Sasha: FYI — Chenango reported weird outputs after our LoRA merge. Numeric amounts are being spelled out in some locales (e.g., 1200 -> ‘mille deux cents’). Not consistent across prompts.
Michael: Oof. Is this a tokenizer issue or something in the adapter? Any example prompts/outputs?
Sasha: Example from their reported quickpack:
User prompt: "Invoice total: $1,200.00"
Model output (en_US): "Invoice total: $1,200.00" (ok)
Model output (fr_FR): "Total de la facture : mille deux cents dollars" (bad, should keep numeric)
Anya: Interesting. Could be adapter finetune encouraging verbalization. Did we train on localized text samples that spell numbers?
Diego: I pulled the adapter training log: training corpus had a small subset of French invoices scraped from forum posts. Some had spelled-out amounts. Loss/learning rates look normal. No explicit locale tags.
Sasha: Repro steps I ran locally with the merged LoRA + base-quant (4-bit) on devbox:
```
python eval_pack.py --model base-xl-4bit --adapter chenango-lora-v1 --prompts invoices_fr.json --batch 16
```
Outputs: 60% numeric-preserve, 40% spelled-out (inconsistent). With base model alone it's 98% numeric-preserve.
Michael: That suggests the adapter introduced behavior. Can we run a quick diff comparing top-k token probs for the number tokenization span pre/post adapter?
Diego: Doing that now. Pasted small snippet:
```
--- base
tokens: ["$","1",",","200",".","00"] probs: [0.95,0.92,0.98,...]
--- base+chenango-lora
tokens: ["mille","deux","cents"] probs: [0.6,0.5,0.45]
```
Eval-bot: automated eval finished: 250 examples, numeric_preserve: base 0.98, base+adapter 0.61, BLEU diff -0.03, hallucination count +12
Anya: Could be copying training distribution. Quick remediation: we can add a small safety patch via adapter edit (soft prompt or tiny delta) that biases towards numeral tokens when currency markers present.
Chloe: If we patch, watch quantized behavior — 4-bit may amplify token prob shifts. Also need to check for regression on other locales.
Sasha: Proposed short plan:
1) create a 200-example patch set (fr invoices with numerals) and fine-tune a 1k-step adapter delta
2) run quick eval pack (eval-bot) against en/fr/es sets + regression suite
3) if pass, release new adapter v1.1 and run canary for Chenango
Michael: I'll spin up a small job on dedicated infra. Diego — can you craft the patch set? Anya — want to author the loss/temperature guard for the patch training?
Diego: Yep. Will assemble examples and run a 1k-step on a single A10 — should be fast. Will post checkpoints here.
Anya: I'll add a token-preserve loss term and clamp temperature during sampling in eval harness.
infra-bot: deploy request queued: small adapter-retrain job on A10 (2h max). Job id: a10-873912
Sasha: Thanks. Also flagging Chenango CSM so they're aware of a fix-in-flight: @chenango-csm :eyes:
Chloe: One more ask — add a unit test to the evalpack for currency markers so this doesn't regress again.
Sasha: Agreed. I'll add it to the quickpack. Will update thread when the patch checkpoint is up.
Diego: checkpoint uploaded: s3://redwood-dev/chenango/patch-v1-2026-03-22.ckpt
Sasha: Kicking off eval-run now. eval-bot will post results when done. :pray:
